instrument_lookup_has_text.name: instrument_lookup_has_text
instrument_lookup_has_text.value: "instrument_lookup"."symbol" IS NOT NULL OR "instrument_lookup"."query" IS NOT NULL

instrument_option_fields.name: instrument_option_fields
instrument_option_fields.value: ("instrument"."asset_class" = 'option') = ("instrument"."expiry" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."strike" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."option_right" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."underlying_id" IS NOT NULL)

instrument_future_fields.name: instrument_future_fields
instrument_future_fields.value: "instrument"."asset_class" <> 'future' OR ("instrument"."future_root" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."contract_month" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."expiry" IS NOT NULL)

strategy_library_entry_idx.name: strategy_library_entry_idx
strategy_library_entry_idx.where: "strategy"."library_entry_id" is not null and "strategy"."deleted_at" is null

strategy_lab_number_shape.name: strategy_lab_number_shape
strategy_lab_number_shape.value: "strategy"."lab_number" is null or ("strategy"."lab_number" = 'S' || lpad("strategy"."lab_sequence_no"::text, greatest(5, length("strategy"."lab_sequence_no"::text)), '0') || '-' || "strategy"."lab_asset_class_code" || "strategy"."lab_timeframe_code" and "strategy"."lab_convention_version" is not null and "strategy"."lab_numbered_at" is not null)

strategy_library_entries_retired.name: strategy_library_entries_retired
strategy_library_entries_retired.value: ("strategy_library_entries"."status" = 'retired') = ("strategy_library_entries"."retired_at" is not null and "strategy_library_entries"."retired_reason" is not null)
